about_item: All SIZE SUPPLIED: EHEYCIGA dog beds for medium, large and extra large dogs have many sizes which can fit all kinds of scenes including using in dog kennels and crates, and placing directly on the floor to bring you convenience to choose the best suitable dog bed for large dogs.
SUPPORTIVE EGG-CRATE FOAM: Our orthopedic dog bed large constructed with 3.5 inches high density egg foam and will provide great support and comfort for dogs and cats.
SUPPORTIVE FOAM CHOSEN: Our foam dog mat constructed with 3.5-inch high density finest quality foam slab give your pal a perfectly comfy place.
ULTIMATE SLEEP SURFACE: Plush sherpa top and non-skid bottom of EHEYCIGA flat dog mattress bed creates ultimate softness and coziness for your pets without moving everywhere.

CARE INSTRUCTIONS: Zippered removable cover is machine washable. Tumble dry on low heat. DO NOT BLEACH. DO NOT IRON. Please note that the inner foam is not washable. After receiving it, leave it for 24-48h for rebound.

summary.text: Customers find the dog bed to be of good quality, comfortable, and easy to wash, with one customer noting it's orthopedic for their dog. The bed receives positive feedback for its value, with customers saying it's exceptional for the price. The size and thickness receive mixed reviews - while some find it great for large dogs and super thick, others say it's too small and not the thickest. The durability is also mixed, with some saying it lasts a long time while others report the cover falling apart.

authors_reviews.title: Comfy, Supportive, and Washable – Bought a Second One!
authors_reviews.text: These are honestly some of the best dog beds I’ve found. I ended up buying another one for the new dog because the first has held up so well. The orthopedic foam is supportive without being stiff, and the removable washable cover is a huge plus.It fits the crate perfectly, and there are lots of great color choices to match your setup.If you have a dog that’s still in training, you can slip a puppy pad inside the cover to help protect the foam — works great and keeps everything cleaner.Super comfortable for the dogs and the price point is excellent for what you get. Definitely recommend!
authors_reviews.author: PawsandProjects

authors_reviews.title: Overall Great bed!
authors_reviews.text: I am very happy with this bed & so is my Furball! He has arthritis & this bed is perfect for him. It is soft & comfortable yet firm to give him support. He is a 68lb Australian Shepherd/Akita & it fits him perfectly with a little extra room. I also got it for a very good price!

authors_reviews.title: Nice bed, but top fabric is poor quality
authors_reviews.text: We got this to go in our puppy's crate as we didn't want her sleeping on the hard plastic bottom - we wanted her to be cozy. This fit perfectly and is a nice thickness. We also liked that the top was a soft material that wasn't super noisy when she moved around. Unfortunately, while it looks nice and cozy when brand new (first picture) , the top material soon gets flat, pilled, and matted down. We also found that once it got all matted and pilled, our puppy would then chew on the fuzz and try to pluck it out. It is also the type of material that traps everything in it, so if they eat anything on it, the crumbs all get trapped in the fabric (see second picture taken after a month of use). If the top had been made with a better quality fleece, this could have been perfect, as it really is a nice bed, but instead is a bit disappointing. A simple change in fabric would go a long way.
authors_reviews.author: sec682

authors_reviews.title: Perfect replacement
authors_reviews.text: This bed fits my dog's crate perfectly. Within 10 minutes after I laid it inside, Maisie and Izzy both hopped in and did their faux-digging moves to fluff it up. I found no snags, rips, or bunching afterwards. I like that the cover can be unzipped and washed and that the foam is a good 4-inches thick. The bed arrived compressed and rolled-up and fluffed perfectly within 10 minutes. This exceeds my expectations as a replacement for a worn out dog bed for inside a crate.
authors_reviews.author: DAO53
